description: Angular component for a dashboard image dialog, allowing users to capture, preview, and save dashboard images, including screenshot functionality using html2canvas.

classes.name: DashboardImageDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for dashboard image dialog, enabling screenshot capture, image preview, and saving dashboard images.

methods.name: convertUserPercent
methods.description: Converts a user input percentage to a decimal value between 0 and 1, with a default fallback.

methods.name: takeScreenShot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a specified dashboard element area using html2canvas and updates the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current dashboard image to the dashboard service and closes the dialog.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Updates the component's image URL with a new image.
